findings.reason: Raw chicken is in a covered box on the bottom shelf; cooked food is covered on the top shelf.
Soap is present, water runs and the basin is clean.
Both dustbins have closed lids and are not overflowing.
Light food residue remains on one corner of the cutting board.
The cook wears a head covering, gloves and a clean apron.
Two packets show readable expiry dates in 2027.

liveness.observed: A hand holds up three fingers in front of the gas stove.

continuousTake.detail: Single continuous take; lighting and room stay consistent.

sameKitchenAsReference.detail: Same tiles, gas range and fridge position as the reference.

activityMatchesOrders.detail: Food is being prepared and utensils are in use.

propsSuspected.detail: Packs are opened and partly used.

integrity.kitchenSummary: Compact kitchen with white wall tiles and a steel two-burner gas range on the left. A single-door fridge stands beside a steel handwash sink near the entrance.

en: Give the cutting board one more scrub at the corners after each rush.
Keep up the great work on fridge storage and dustbin lids.
hi: हर व्यस्त समय के बाद कटिंग बोर्ड के कोनों को एक बार और रगड़ कर साफ़ करें।
फ्रिज भंडारण और डस्टबिन ढक्कन पर अच्छा काम जारी रखें।
or: ପ୍ରତି ବ୍ୟସ୍ତ ସମୟ ପରେ କଟିଂ ବୋର୍ଡର କୋଣଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଆଉ ଥରେ ଘଷି ସଫା କରନ୍ତୁ।
ଫ୍ରିଜ ସଂରକ୍ଷଣ ଏବଂ ଡଷ୍ଟବିନ ଢାଙ୍କୁଣିରେ ଭଲ କାମ ଜାରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
